Trace, implement and test: 16.02.Words Frequency

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class WordsFrequency {
public:
    WordsFrequency(vector<string>& book) {
        for (auto& x : book) {
            ++cnt[x];
        }
    }

    int get(string word) {
        return cnt[word];
    }

private:
    unordered_map<string, int> cnt;
};

/**
 * Your WordsFrequency object will be instantiated and called as such:
 * WordsFrequency* obj = new WordsFrequency(book);
 * int param_1 = obj->get(word);
 */
